text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the morning, before classes started—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... My head feels so heavy,
my voice won't come out properly...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Kh... At this rate, I won't be able to deliver
my awakening voice to all living beings...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, everyone will become anxious.
I must prevent that at all costs...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her loud screams of agony from the
headache echoed all around...
